material.acceptance_criteria: A served scenarios/moba room with a disposable mod that attacks the side-1 base reports winner 0 or 1 on GET /state, witnessed by a live run that names the leader hypothesis (side-0 units do not reach the base).
material.description: Witness run for gap-moba-winner-readout-blocker-gm-orch-1-15 (session gm-orch-1-22). Served room: oscraftd --data scenarios/moba --mod <disposable fog-off mod> --ticks 100000000 (binary rust/target/debug/oscraftd built 22:11, HEAD e03ee19). The base is the side-1 unit with the highest hp, id 1 (spawned first in map.osd; catalog declaration index 2 is 'base', but GET /state records carry a sim kind, not the catalog index, so kind 2 does not appear). Mod: game.cmd_set_fog(false) once, then every owner-0 unit game.cmd_attack on the side-1 unit with the most hp. Measured: the base hp fell 98304000 -> 51642368 by tick 1702 and was 51380224 at tick 2600 and 49283072 at tick 2776 (side-1 base hp at 2776 on the last state read: 51380224 for id 1; id 19 at 49283072 is a side-1 unit). winner stayed -1 through tick 2776. Side-0 attackers (ids 0,4,6,8,14,16,18,20-23) sat at x 181k-450k while the base is at x ~2.3M, so attack orders are accepted (applied=21 per tick) but do not close distance. Without fog off, the orders were refused because the base was unseen (mod-host test cmd_attack_on_an_unseen_target_is_refused_by_the_sim). Not witnessed: no RESULT line; the row stays pending. Next probe: measure per-attacker distance to the target across ticks and whether units reach weapon range; a longer tick bound (the run took about 4.5 minutes for 2800 ticks at tick-budget-us 20000).
material.subject: Blocker: side-0 mod attack orders stall short of the side-1 base, so no winner by tick 2776
material.witness: commit 0ca2fb6301b7865edbd3f5e08f5096dddf1194fb; CI run 39081397284 success; live witness winner=0 tick=1416 (dispatch 1792282344638-500-228c2b1fdbce93bc)
material.witness_plan: Run oscraftd --data scenarios/moba --mod <temp mod> --ticks N, poll GET /state, print the winner, tick, and the base hp each 500 ticks; a stall prints RESULT: FAIL with the distance measurement.
